```{python}
import gradio as gr
import plotly.express as px

datasets = {
    "iris": px.data.iris(),
    "gapminder": px.data.gapminder(),
    "tips": px.data.tips(),
}

def plot_figure(dataset):
    data = datasets[dataset]
    return px.scatter(
        data,
        x=data.columns[0],
        y=data.columns[1],
        color=data.columns[-1],
        title=f"{dataset.title()} dataset",
    )

gr.Interface(
    fn=plot_figure,
    inputs=gr.Dropdown(choices=list(datasets), value="iris"),
    outputs="plot",
    flagging_mode="never",
).launch()
```
